Container.Name: excaliself
Container.Overview: Self-hosted Excalidraw with accounts, folders, search, live collaboration, single sign-on, and an MCP server. Requires a PostgreSQL database: install the Postgres17 (or any Postgres) container from Community Applications first, create a database and user, and point DATABASE_URL at it. Open the WebUI and the first visit takes you to /setup to create the admin account.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the web app listens on.

Config.Name: DATABASE_URL
Config.Description: PostgreSQL connection URL. Use a hex password: it goes into a URL.

Config.Name: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
Config.Description: Session signing secret. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: BASE_URL
Config.Description: The public URL you open Excaliself at, including http(s):// and port if not 80/443. Must match for sign-in and collaboration links.

Config.Name: OIDC_ISSUER
Config.Description: Optional generic OIDC provider (Authentik, Keycloak, Okta).

Config.Name: SSO_ALLOWED_DOMAINS
Config.Description: Optional: email domains that may join on first SSO sign-in.
